Decision: authorized_as_is.

The revised four-hypothesis set (HYP-001, HYP-002R, HYP-003R, HYP-004R) is verified distinct from all concluded families. No drops, no reductions. It proceeds to Karl sign-off recording.

1. HYP-004R's session filter must be load-bearing in the compiled spec, not cosmetic over an EMA-momentum signal.
2. HYP-003R and HYP-004R carry their `pass_with_caution` context into their result records.

LAB-RT-HYP-004R: session_hours_utc must remain an explicit denominator axis or equivalent load-bearing gate
final compiled/formalized execution must not reduce to EMA/SMA momentum with a cosmetic session wrapper

result interpretation must explicitly read against RP-2592 / RP-3731 / RP-6236 context
frozen mechanics must remain EMA-side body/ATR impulse + RVOL + UTC session filter, not fast/slow SMA crossover momentum
LAB-RT-HYP-003R: pass_with_caution context must be carried into future result records
result interpretation must explicitly read against RP-7134 / STRAT-SPEC-0003 context

all_hypotheses: if any hypothesis screens GO later, execution must stop-and-surface to Karl as a real candidate decision
